title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省 Anilao市镇某小村移交给Same省 Banate市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Transferring Certain Sitios of the Municipality of Anilao, Province of Iloilo, to the Municipality of Banate, Same Province
title.orig: An Act Transferring Certain Sitios of the Municipality of Anilao, Province of Iloilo, to the Municipality of Banate, Same Province

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4614_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provisions of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred and seventy-one to the contrary notwithstanding, the former sitios of Bato, Bat-us, Himogbugan, Mumwick, Dangula-an, Agloy-a, Ilawod, Tangcong, Dalipe, Lampuyang, Agcarope and Agloy-a, Ilaya, all in the Municipality of Anilao, Province of Iloilo, are hereby separated from the said municipality and transferred to the Municipality of Banate to form parts of the barrios to which they respectively belonged before the approval of said Act.

This Act shall take effect on February first, nineteen hundred sixty-six, if a majority of the qualified voters in the aforementioned sitios vote in favor of the transfer of said sitios to the Municipality of Banate, Province of Iloilo, as provided in this Act in a plebiscite which shall be held on January fifteen, nineteen hundred sixty-six under the supervision of the Provincial Board of the Province of Iloilo.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
